name: Kettlebell Snatch
description: The single-arm kettlebell snatch — one continuous, explosive movement that takes the bell from a backswing between the legs to a locked-out overhead position. Hinge and hike the bell back, then snap the hips to send it up the body in a tight arc, punching the hand through at the top so the bell rolls and lands SOFTLY on the back of the forearm rather than banging the wrist. Lower it under control back into the next hinge. The hips drive the bell, not the arm; the punch-through and a smooth catch are what protect the shoulder and wrist. The foundational kettlebell ballistic — full-body power, grip, and conditioning in one rep.
